payload.text: I'm organizing a volunteer orientation on Friday from 14:00 to 16:00 for eight new volunteers. Priya can explain safeguarding, Mateo can show people around, and Alex can handle sign-in and questions; all three are available throughout. Everyone needs a 20-minute safeguarding briefing at the start, two 25-minute tours, and 15 minutes at the end for questions and next steps. Some volunteers may need step-free access, but I don't yet know how many. Help me get this ready to run and make the open decisions clear. Don't contact anyone or make bookings.
